note: Encoder fingerprints recorded as FACTS: which encoder table / which re-encode format the file's own bytes equal. A match never means 'came from X', never manipulation or authenticity — anyone can reproduce the same table or the same ffmpeg output. Every entry names its source; nothing is estimated. Per-camera-make JPEG tables are deliberately absent: no citable published table set was found, so the EXIF-make cue compares against the IJG library default only (see docs/FACT-LAYERS.md for adding a table from a reference capture).

jpeg_ijg_standard.meaning: IJG libjpeg 표준 양자화표(ITU-T T.81 부록 K 표 K.1·K.2)를 품질 값으로 배율한 표
jpeg_ijg_standard.scaling: scale = 5000/Q (Q<50) or 200-2Q (Q>=50); value = (base*scale+50)/100, at least 1, at most 32767, at most 255 when force_baseline
jpeg_ijg_standard.source: ITU-T Rec. T.81 (09/1992) | ISO/IEC 10918-1, Annex K.1, Tables K.1 and K.2 (https://www.w3.org/Graphics/JPEG/itu-t81.pdf); scaling from IJG libjpeg jcparam.c jpeg_quality_scaling() and jpeg_add_quant_table(), identical in libjpeg-turbo (https://github.com/libjpeg-turbo/libjpeg-turbo/blob/main/src/jcparam.c, checked 2026-10-27)
jpeg_ijg_standard.confidence: 표준 문서와 공개 소스 코드(재현 가능: libjpeg 계열로 품질 Q 저장 시 같은 표)
jpeg_ijg_standard.users: libjpeg·libjpeg-turbo를 쓰는 프로그램(Pillow, ImageMagick·GIMP 기본 설정, 다수의 브라우저·변환기·서버)과 일부 카메라. mozjpeg 기본 표, Photoshop, Apple 이미지 저장은 다른 표를 씁니다.
